title: Light Buttery Mediterranean Chicken Pasta
description: A quick and flavorful Mediterranean dish featuring chicken, pasta, and a hint of Thai green curry paste, finished with a tangy nuka-pickle topping.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned and cooked through.
Add the Thai green curry paste to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Stir in the chopped nuka-pickle, Kalamata olives, and artichoke hearts, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir in the chopped parsley and grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and Parmesan cheese if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
